lines.en: label library35:
scene futabarinlib1
I walk into the library to find Futaba and Rin caught in a conversation amidst an otherwise empty room.
lines.zh: 我走进图书馆，发现 Futaba 和 Rin 正在空无一人的房间里聊得正起劲。

lines.en: The two of them don’t notice my presence right away so I decide to eavesdrop on their conversation and listen into whatever juicy stuff girls talk about when they’re alone.
lines.zh: 她们俩没有立刻注意到我，于是我决定偷听一下，看看女生独处时究竟会聊些什么劲爆的话题。

lines.en: : Yeah so I basically just kept rolling 5’s the entire night.
lines.zh: : 就是说啊，我基本上整晚都在掷 5。

lines.en: : I’m thinking of buying new dice, but I can’t figure out which color I want.
lines.zh: : 我在考虑买新骰子，但一直拿不准想要什么颜色。

lines.en: : I have an extra pair I could give you. I don’t really have a use for two sets and it’s not like I’m going to switch back and forth mid-game or anything.
lines.zh: : 我有多出来的一副，可以给你。两副我也用不上，而且我也不可能在游戏中途换来换去什么的。

lines.en: Okay, this conversation is boring. It’s time for me to step in.
lines.zh: 好吧，这话题挺无聊的。我该出场了。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib2
: Aren’t girls supposed to talk about fun stuff while there aren’t any guys around?
lines.zh: : 女生在没有男生在场的时候，不是应该聊点有意思的东西吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean? D&D is tons of fun. Don’t complain just cause you’re a buzzkill.
lines.zh: : 什么意思？D&D 可有意思了。别因为你自己是个扫兴鬼就抱怨。

lines.en: : What are you even doing here? Don’t you have work today?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？你今天不用上班吗？

lines.en: : Rin took the day off and is going to hang out with me here.
lines.zh: : Rin 今天请假了，要来这儿陪我。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib3
: Of course I took the day off. You’re always there to help me out, so who would I be to not be around for you?
lines.zh: : 我当然是请了假的。你总是在帮我，我要是不在你身边，那我算什么？

lines.en: : First Nodoka and now Rin. People seem to be flocking to you all of a sudden, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 先是 Nodoka，现在又是 Rin。Futaba，突然间大家好像都往你身边凑了。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib4
: It really does seem that way. All I did was let my hair down.
lines.zh: : 看起来确实是这样。我也只是把头发放下来而已。

lines.en: : I had no idea it would make this much of a difference.
lines.zh: : 我完全没想到会有这么大的差别。

lines.en: : Is that just how you’re going to keep it from now on?
lines.zh: : 那你以后就打算一直这样了？

lines.en: : I don’t know...I do like all of the attention I’m getting all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我确实挺喜欢这种突然被关注的感觉。

lines.en: : Even if that attention is really only from you two and Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 哪怕这种关注其实只来自你们两个和 Nodoka。

lines.en: : Sooo Sensei finally met Nodoka. Any thoughts? Love at first sight?
lines.zh: : 那——Sensei 终于见到 Nodoka 了。有什么感想吗？一见钟情？

lines.en: : Why would I fall in love with her at first sight?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要对她一见钟情？

lines.en: : Because you both wear glasses and...write stuff?
lines.zh: : 因为你们俩都戴眼镜，而且……都写东西？

lines.en: : Makoto and I both wear glasses and write stuff as well.
lines.zh: : Makoto 和我也都戴眼镜、都写东西啊。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib5
: Oh my God, are you in love with Makoto?!
lines.zh: : 天哪，你该不会是喜欢 Makoto 吧？！

lines.en: : I knew something fishy was going on with you two!
lines.zh: : 我就知道你们俩之间有猫腻！

lines.en: : Shh, quiet. She’ll hear you.
lines.zh: : 嘘，小声点。她会听见的。

lines.en: : She {i}is{/i} rather fond of you...
lines.zh: : 她对你{i}倒是{/i}挺有好感的……

lines.en: : I personally wouldn’t be surprised if, well, you know...
lines.zh: : 我个人倒是不会觉得意外，就是……你懂的……

lines.en: : Okay, well let’s not drag her into this and make things any more complicated than they need to be.
lines.zh: : 好了，我们别把她扯进来，把事情弄得比必要的更复杂。

lines.en: : Rin.
lines.zh: : Rin。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib6
: Me.
: You said something about being there for Futaba when she’s always there for you.
lines.zh: : 你说过，Futaba 总是陪在你身边，所以你也要陪在她身边。

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 我是说过。

lines.en: : What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思？

lines.en: : It’s cause she hasn’t been feeling well. I thought you knew that?
lines.zh: : 因为她身体一直不太舒服。我还以为你知道呢？

lines.en: : Umm...I’m...right here...
lines.zh: : 呃……我就……在这儿啊……

lines.en: : I’d appreciate it if you two wouldn’t talk about me like I’m not...
lines.zh: : 希望你们俩别把我当空气一样谈论我……

lines.en: : I did, but I still don’t know exactly what is wrong.
lines.zh: : 我知道，但我还是不清楚到底是哪里不对劲。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib7
: It’s...a fever. Right?
lines.zh: : 是……发烧。对吧？

lines.en: : I've told her over and over to hold off on working until it breaks, but she seems weirdly adamant about still coming despite having to spend literally the whole day here.
lines.zh: : 我跟她说过无数次了，让她烧退之前先别来工作，可她固执得奇怪，明明一整天都得耗在这儿，还非要来不可。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib8
: Well...it’s the only time I really get to see you and...you know. Books. And stuff.
lines.zh: : 可是……这是我能真正见到你的唯一时间，而且……你知道的。还有书。之类的。

lines.en: : As much as I appreciate being next to books in your top interests, it would mean a lot to me if you’d put yourself first for once.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很荣幸能在你最在意的东西里排到书旁边，但如果你能偶尔把自己放在第一位，我会很欣慰的。

lines.en: : For real. We have books in our dorm. The[school] will understand if you’re not feeling well.
lines.zh: : 说真的。我们宿舍里也有书。你要是不舒服，[school]会理解的。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib9
: Can we not do this right now?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能现在别谈这个？

lines.en: : It’s not like working in the library is physically exhausting. I just need to stand around and...make sure I enter the returns into the computer.
lines.zh: : 在图书馆工作又不会消耗体力。我只要站着……把归还的书录入电脑就行了。

lines.en: : No one’s even here, though. Can't you just-
lines.zh: : 可这儿根本没人啊。你就不能——

lines.en: scene futabarinlib10
: Just fucking drop it, okay?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈别说了行吗？！

lines.en: : I appreciate that you’re looking out for me, but I’m fine!
lines.zh: : 我很感谢你们关心我，但我没事！

lines.en: I guess it’s good that no one else is around today as Futaba would clearly be making a scene if anyone was.
lines.zh: 幸好今天没别人在，不然 Futaba 这样子显然要闹出动静来。

lines.en: I think this might be the first time I’ve ever heard her raise her voice and it’s...strange.
lines.zh: 我想这大概是我第一次听见她提高嗓门，感觉……很怪。

lines.en: I can’t say I like it.
lines.zh: 我不能说我喜欢这样。

lines.en: Something’s definitely going on with her.
lines.zh: 她身上肯定出了什么事。

lines.en: And if Rin nor myself is able to get it out, I’m beginning to worry that we really might just have to let her deal with it on her own.
lines.zh: 如果 Rin 和我都没办法问出来，我开始担心，也许真的只能让她自己一个人扛了。

lines.en: I suppose that’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得那样也行。

lines.en: I’ve always believed that solving things on your own is the best way to become stronger.
lines.zh: 我一直相信，靠自己解决问题是变强的最好方式。

lines.en: And while I’ve definitely been trying to help her to a certain extent, it’s impossible to deny that most of this has been due to my own curiosity rather than a need to make her feel better.
lines.zh: 虽然我确实在一定程度上试着帮过她，但不可否认，这多半是出于我自己的好奇心，而不是想让她好受些。

lines.en: : Woah...
lines.zh: : 哇哦……

lines.en: scene futabarinlib11
: Oh- no! {i}I’m{/i} sorry!
lines.zh: : 哦——不！{i}对不起{/i}！

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to yell at you like that. I’ve just been under a lot of stress lately and...
lines.zh: : 我不是有意那样对你吼的。我只是最近压力太大了，而且……

lines.en: : And I wish you two wouldn’t keep trying to get involved.
lines.zh: : 而且我希望你们俩别老是想插手。

lines.en: : It’s nice but it really is just making things...a little harder for me.
lines.zh: : 我是很感激，但这真的只是让事情……变得更难了一点。

lines.en: : We just want you to know that we’re here for you.
lines.zh: : 我们只是想让你知道，我们一直在你身边。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib12
: I get that...but what help does it do to just keep saying you’re there for someone over and over and over?
lines.zh: : 我明白……可是一遍又一遍地说「我在你身边」，到底有什么用？

lines.en: : I obviously know that you’re there for me and I’m glad you are...but if I wanted your help, I would have accepted it by now.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道你们在我身边，我也很高兴……可如果我需要你们帮忙，我早就接受了。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib13
: With my parents traveling as much as they have my whole life, I’ve never really had anyone to {i}care{/i} for me during times like this.
lines.zh: : 我父母这辈子一直在到处旅行，这种时候从来没有人真正{i}照顾{/i}过我。

lines.en: : Until Rin, that is.
lines.zh: : 直到 Rin 出现，才有人。

lines.en: : Don’t.
lines.zh: : 别说了。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib14
: Huh?
: Don’t say anything about how you need to deal with certain things on your own.
lines.zh: : 别再说什么有些事你得自己扛了。

lines.en: : That’s where you were going, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你正要往那儿说，对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Until I met Rin, I was always alone. But she can’t fix everything.{/i} Blah blah blah independence and responsibility or whatever. Get real.
lines.zh: : {i}在遇到 Rin 之前，我一直都是一个人。但她不可能什么都替我解决。{/i}独立自主、责任感什么的，说得好听。现实点吧。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be so worried about you if you would actually start taking care of yourself.
lines.zh: : 你要是真开始好好照顾自己，我也不会这么担心你了。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib15
: Are you saying...I can’t take care of myself?
lines.zh: : 你是说……我照顾不了自己？

lines.en: : No, I’m saying you {i}won’t{/i} take care of yourself. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 不，我是说你{i}不肯{/i}照顾自己。这不一样。

lines.en: : You’re perfectly capable of doing it and you still choose not to.
lines.zh: : 你完全有能力做到，可你就是选择不做。

lines.en: : Then you get all mad when the people who are closest to you start to notice something is going on.
lines.zh: : 然后当最亲近的人开始察觉到不对劲时，你又冲他们发火。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m beginning to think Rin knows a little more about what’s {i}going on{/i} than I do.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我开始觉得 Rin 知道的{i}事情{/i}比我多一些了。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to think that, too. And I’d appreciate it if she and I could talk about it {i}alone{/i}, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我也这么觉得了。而且我希望她能和我{i}单独{/i}谈谈，Sensei……

lines.en: scene futabarinlib16
: I want him here.
lines.zh: : 我想让他留下。

lines.en: : He’s important to me.
lines.zh: : 他对我很重要。

lines.en: : And he’s important to you too.
lines.zh: : 他对你也很重要。

lines.en: I can’t help but feel like I’ve somehow gotten wrapped up in a rare dispute between best friends when all I wanted to do was hang out with Futaba.
lines.zh: 我不由得觉得，自己莫名其妙地被卷进了一场闺蜜之间少有的争执里，而我本来只是想和 Futaba 待在一起而已。

lines.en: But obviously, these are [teenager]s we’re dealing with. Things like this are bound to happen and I should never believe otherwise.
lines.zh: 但显然，我们面对的是[teenager]。这种事迟早会发生，我本不该抱有别的期待。

lines.en: This is still Futaba’s call, though. If she doesn’t want me here, I shouldn’t be here.
lines.zh: 不过这仍然是 Futaba 的决定。如果她不想让我在这儿，我就不该在这儿。

lines.en: She and Rin can talk about this and I’ll just...avoid confrontation and pick up where we left off once the matter is resolved.
lines.zh: 她和 Rin 可以谈，我就……回避一下冲突，等事情解决了再接着来。

lines.en: : Thanks, Rin. But I’ll step away for a little while and let the two of you talk.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Rin。不过我先出去一会儿，让你们俩谈谈。

lines.en: : If Futaba wants to keep something secret, she shouldn’t be obligated to share it.
lines.zh: : 如果 Futaba 想保守什么秘密，她没有义务非得说出来。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib17
: Even if it’s dangerous?...
lines.zh: : 就算很危险？……

lines.en: : It’s still up to her to decide.
lines.zh: : 那还是由她自己来决定。

lines.en: : I’ll be back in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 我几分钟后回来。

lines.en: scene black
I quietly make my way out of the library and lean up against the wall.
lines.zh: 我悄悄走出图书馆，靠在墙上。

lines.en: No one is around, so it doesn’t look like the two of them will be interrupted any time soon.
lines.zh: 周围没有人，看来她们俩短时间内不会被打扰。

lines.en: But, in the event that someone {i}does{/i} show up, I can probably just use my teacher-powers to tell them the library is closed or something.
lines.zh: 不过万一{i}真{/i}有人来，我大概可以动用我的老师权力，告诉他们图书馆闭馆之类的。

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene futabarinlib18
: Futaba...
lines.zh: : Futaba……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : Soooooo ‘effing much.
lines.zh: : 爱到不行、不行、不行的那种。

lines.en: : But you need. To. Stop. This.
lines.zh: : 但你得。给。我。停下。

lines.en: : It’s dangerous.
lines.zh: : 这很危险。

lines.en: : Stop what, Rin?
lines.zh: : 停下什么，Rin？

lines.en: : What are you saying?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？

lines.en: : You’re really going to make me say it?
lines.zh: : 你真要我亲口说出来？

lines.en: : You didn't have any problems making {i}me{/i} say it when I found out you were cutting yourself. So, yeah. I am.
lines.zh: : 当初我发现你自残的时候，逼{i}我{/i}说出来可一点都没客气。所以，对，我要你说。

lines.en: : Fine, then. I'll say it.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我来说。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib19
: When was the last time you ate anything?
lines.zh: : 你上一次吃东西是什么时候？

lines.en: : Yester-
lines.zh: : 昨天——

lines.en: : {i}Without{/i} fucking...throwing it up right away.
lines.zh: : 我是说{i}没有{/i}他妈的……马上吐出来的那种。

lines.en: : I know that's what's going on...
lines.zh: : 我知道是怎么回事……

lines.en: : You did the same fucking thing in middle[school].
lines.zh: : 你上 middle[school] 的时候就干过一模一样的事。

lines.en: : You don’t want Sensei to know because it’s embarrassing, right?
lines.zh: : 你不想让 Sensei 知道，因为那很丢人，对吧？

lines.en: : You know he’ll just say something about how he thinks you’re beautiful no matter what.
lines.zh: : 你知道他一定会说，不管怎样他都觉得你很美。

lines.en: : But you don't think that.
lines.zh: : 可你自己不这么想。

lines.en: : And no compliments mean {i}anything{/i} if you don’t think that...Right?
lines.zh: : 而如果你自己不这么想，再多的夸奖也没有{i}意义{/i}……对吧？

lines.en: : It’s just like how I have to lean on hurting myself to feel better sometimes.
lines.zh: : 就像我有时候也得靠伤害自己才好受一点。

lines.en: : I get it. I really do.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我真的懂。

lines.en: : Say something.
lines.zh: : 你说话啊。

lines.en: : You don’t get it. It’s not the same thing.
lines.zh: : 你不懂。这不是一回事。

lines.en: : You don’t have actual {i}reasons{/i} to feel the way you do. You’ve said it yourself a million times.
lines.zh: : 你没有真正的{i}理由{/i}去感受你现在感受的那种东西。这话你自己说过一万遍了。

lines.en: : It just happens...
lines.zh: : 它就那么发生了……

lines.en: scene futabarinlib20
: Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: : I love you too. More than anyone.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。胜过任何人。

lines.en: : All I’m doing is trying to feel a little better about myself.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让自己好受一点。

lines.en: : And it’s been working! I’ve...lost a few pounds ever since the beach and...And I’ve even started wearing my hair differently.
lines.zh: : 而且这招有用！从海边那次之后我……瘦了好几磅，而且……我连发型都换了。

lines.en: : I'm reinventing myself!
lines.zh: : 我在重塑自己！

lines.en: : Things are getting better!
lines.zh: : 一切都在变好！

lines.en: : I’ll go back to normal soon.
lines.zh: : 我很快就会恢复正常。

lines.en: : I just want to be a little happier first.
lines.zh: : 我只是想先让自己开心一点。

lines.en: : Things like this don’t make you happier! They make it worse! You're literally destroying your body.
lines.zh: : 这种事不会让你开心！只会更糟！你这是在一点一点毁掉自己的身体。

lines.en: : Good. This body deserves to be destroyed.
lines.zh: : 很好。这具身体就活该被毁掉。

lines.en: : And besides, isn't this the pot calling the kettle black right now?
lines.zh: : 再说了，眼下这算不算五十步笑百步？

lines.en: scene futabarinlib21
: Fuck the pot and fuck the kettle!
lines.zh: : 去他妈的五十步，去他妈的百步！

lines.en: : This is your best-friend...your {i}sister{/i} begging you to stop killing yourself because you don't like how you look!
lines.zh: : 这是你最好的朋友……你的{i}姐姐{/i}在求你别再因为不喜欢自己的样子而要了自己的命！

lines.en: : We can go to the gym together! I’ll go on a diet with you! I’ll do whatever you want!
lines.zh: : 我们可以一起去健身房！我可以陪你一起节食！你要我做什么都行！

lines.en: : Just cut it out already!
lines.zh: : 求你别再这样了！

lines.en: : Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: : I mean it! I’m not kidding!
lines.zh: : 我说真的！不是开玩笑！

lines.en: scene futabarinlib22
: You’re...
: You're not going to tell him...are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会告诉他……对吧？

lines.en: : Of course not!
lines.zh: : 当然不会！

lines.en: : We would have wound up in this same conversation today whether he was here or not.
lines.zh: : 不管他在不在这儿，今天我们都会走到这番对话。

lines.en: : He doesn’t have anything to do with this.
lines.zh: : 这事跟他没关系。

lines.en: : I’m so fucking worried about you. So worried I couldn’t even work.
lines.zh: : 我他妈担心死你了。担心得连班都没法上。

lines.en: : I get that you’re unhappy, but we can start fixing that together! Just like last time!
lines.zh: : 我知道你不开心，但我们可以一起开始解决啊！就像上次一样！

lines.en: : Please...for me.
lines.zh: : 求你了……为了我。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib23
: I’ll try.
lines.zh: : 我会试试。

lines.en: : For you.
lines.zh: : 为了你。

lines.en: : But that's all I can promise.
lines.zh: : 但我只能保证这些。

lines.en: : I don't know if it will work or not.
lines.zh: : 我不知道会不会有用。

lines.en: : But I'll try.
lines.zh: : 但我会试试。

lines.en: : I love you so much.
lines.zh: : 我好爱你。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。

lines.en: : I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: : Thank {i}you{/i}.
lines.zh: : 谢谢{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Even if you’re annoying and won’t let me do things my way.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你很烦人，还总不让我按自己的方式来。

lines.en: : You never let me do things my way either. This is just me returning the favor.
lines.zh: : 你也从来不让我按自己的方式来啊。我这只是礼尚往来。

lines.en: : Hehe...I guess you’re right.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……你说得对。

lines.en: : Should we...maybe tell Sensei it’s okay for him to come back in yet?
lines.zh: : 我们……是不是该告诉 Sensei 可以进来了？

lines.en: scene futabarinlib24
: Umm...hold on one sec.
lines.zh: : 嗯……等一下。

lines.en: : My mascara isn’t running down my face right now, is it?
lines.zh: : 我的睫毛膏现在没晕到脸上吧？

lines.en: : Don’t want to give away that I was crying or anything.
lines.zh: : 可不想让人看出我哭过什么的。

lines.en: scene futabarinlib25
: You look fine...
lines.zh: : 你看起来挺好的……

lines.en: : More than fine.
lines.zh: : 比挺好的更好。

lines.en: : You’re beautiful.
lines.zh: : 你很美。

lines.en: : No, {i}you’re{/i} beautiful.
lines.zh: : 不，{i}你才{/i}美。

lines.en: : No, you.
lines.zh: : 不，你。

lines.en: : No, {i}you.{/i}
scene black
: Excuse me, is there a teacher available to assist two [young_girls] in the library?
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，请问图书馆里有老师能帮两位[young_girls]的忙吗？

lines.en: : There are so many hard-to-reach books and our tiny arms simply can not reach any! Whatever shall we do?
lines.zh: : 有好多书放在特别高的地方，我们小小的手臂根本够不着！我们该怎么办呢？

lines.en: : I am a teacher. I can obtain hard-to-reach books.
lines.zh: : 我是老师。我能够到放在高处的书。

lines.en: : Wonderful! Come quick!
lines.zh: : 太好了！快过来！

lines.en: scene futabarinlib26
: Hey. Glad to see you two didn’t kill each other.
lines.zh: : 嘿。很高兴看到你们俩没有互相把对方宰了。

lines.en: : I was worried that Rin needed help burying a body or something just now.
lines.zh: : 我刚才还担心 Rin 需要人帮忙埋尸体什么的。

lines.en: : Nope. No bodies to be buried just yet.
lines.zh: : 没有。暂时还没有尸体要埋。

lines.en: : We’re fine now. Thanks for stepping out and letting us talk alone.
lines.zh: : 我们现在没事了。谢谢你出去让我们单独谈。

lines.en: : Hey, it’s not my responsibility to solve every problem. Some things are better fixed by others.
lines.zh: : 嘿，解决所有问题又不是我的责任。有些事交给别人处理更好。

lines.en: : I’m just here to hang out with [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: : 我只是来和[teenage]女孩们混在一起的。

lines.en: : Well you get two of them today, so be happy about that while you still can.
lines.zh: : 那今天你一次得到两个，趁着还能高兴就高兴一下吧。

lines.en: : Oh, I will be. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 哦，我会的。别担心。

lines.en: scene black
The rest of the morning goes by rather quickly.
lines.zh: 接下来的一个上午过得相当快。

lines.en: Futaba remains pretty lethargic throughout, but I chalk it up to whatever mystery-ailment is plaguing her as she seems in good spirits otherwise.
lines.zh: Futaba 全程都没什么精神，但我把这归结为纠缠着她的某种神秘小毛病，因为她除此之外看起来心情不错。

lines.en: I’m not sure what the two of them said to each other to defuse the situation so quickly but, whatever it was, I’m glad.
lines.zh: 我不知道她们俩说了什么，能把局面这么快就化解开来，但不管是什么，我很庆幸。

lines.en: I didn’t particularly like seeing angry-Futaba, and I’m perfectly content with never having to see that again, if at all possible.
lines.zh: 我一点都不喜欢看到生气的 Futaba，如果可以的话，我完全不介意这辈子都别再见到。

lines.en: $ library35 = True
$ futaba_love += 1
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
